- Icons turn to any angle, with a soft stop on the quarter turns. Bars and the

text.tspan: - Opening the menu puts the player, target and target-of-target frames on screen,

svg.text: switched-off ones dimmed and tagged OFF. They move and size the same way; they do not turn.

text.tspan: - The grid shows while the menu is open. Snap drops an item on the nearest

svg.text: grid line; Stick makes an item dropped right beside another one click against its edge.

text.tspan: - Nothing can be clicked or moved, so the HUD never gets in the way of the game.

svg.text: Position and turning are done with the mouse; size is done both ways: CTRL + wheel on the item, or
the Scale slider in the menu (one for each bar and each icon). The menu has no X / Y or orientation
